16.
(1)  The  Office  for  Reparations  shall  have  its  own
fund.  There shall be credited  to the fund of the Office for

(a)
all 
such  balances  as  on 
the  date  of 
the
commencement of this Act that are lying to the credit
of  the  Rehabilitation  of  Persons,  Properties  and
Industries Authority, with regard to claims made to
the  Rehabilitation  of  Persons,  Properties  and
Industries Authority, in terms of the Rehabilitation
of Persons, Properties and Industries Authority Act,

(b)
all such sums as may be voted by Parliament from
time to time for the purposes of this Act;

(c)
all such sums as may be received by the Office for
Reparations  by  way  of  donations,  grants  or  gifts,
